## Summary

Describe the focused problem and change.

## Model and compatibility impact

State whether retry semantics, event ordering, capacity accounting, JSON schema,
CLI behaviour, or package API changes.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover changed behaviour or the documentation-only scope is clear.
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`, `ruff check .`, `mypy src`, and `pytest` pass.
- [ ] Examples use synthetic data and label results as simulated.
- [ ] No private data, production trace, secret, or unrelated asset is included.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where required.
